tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background (bg-paper / bg-background). The espresso ground in dark, warm paper in light.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: sidebar rail, tab lists, table footers, unchecked checkbox and switch tracks, neutral badges.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and popovers (bg-card).

tokens.name: elev
tokens.usage: Elevated layer: dropdowns, the active tab, a live card, table row hover, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on paper, paper-2, card and elev (≥13:1 dark, ≥15:1 light). Also the 2px outline colour in light (via border) and the Line button's hover fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, table cells, table heads, quieter stat figures. ≥8.8:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted text: overlines, section labels, card descriptions, captions, placeholders, stat and hour labels, future stepper steps. 5.1:1 or better dark and 5.0:1 or better light on every surface.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Not a text colour (§3.8): dividers, decorative glyphs and disabled marks only. 3.0 to 3.3:1 on dark surfaces and 4.2:1 on light paper-2, so placeholders, stat labels, hour labels and future stepper labels use muted.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers: table row rules, Panel's 1px border, sidebar border.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Default 2px outline in dark (it is what border resolves to there); future stepper ring and connector in both themes.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: RVLT core red, the one accent (locked). The RVLT mark, focus and now rings, strokes, checked-control edges, indicators, doodle lines and sticker fills. As text it is 4.2:1 on dark paper, so red words use red-text; white-on-red fills use action-red (DESIGN.md §3.8). Light: 5.2:1 on paper, 5.9:1 under white.

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Pressed/shadow red: the primary button's hard 3px offset shadow and halo base.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Red tint background: the current stepper step's glow, red tint behind red text.

tokens.name: action-red
tokens.usage: Action fill under white text: primary, halo and destructive buttons, the solid live pill, the full-red CTA block. White on it is 4.8:1 dark, 6.0:1 light. Core red stays for the mark, rings, strokes and indicators (DESIGN.md §3.8).

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red words on a surface: Kalam eyebrows, doodle notes, inline red emphasis. 4.6:1 or better on every dark surface; never core red for text (§3.8).

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Control boundary for inputs, selects, textareas, comboboxes, checkboxes and switches: 3.6:1 or better on every surface (§3.8). Card outlines keep border.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info status text and dots; on blue-soft 5.2:1 dark, 4.5:1 light over every surface (§3.8).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success / available / pass text and dots, on ok-soft: 7.1:1 dark, 4.7:1 light (retoned 2026-10-19). Always with a label.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning / due / prepping text and dots, on warn-soft: 6:1 dark, 4.6:1 light. Always with a label.

tokens.name: rep
tokens.usage: Neutral / returned / in-repair text and dots, on rep-soft (6.1:1 dark, 4.6:1 light).

tokens.name: t-out
tokens.usage: Problem red: overdue, cancelled, failed, conflict, invalid input borders. Text on out-soft (4.95:1 dark, 6.8:1 light). Never the solid brand red.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind ok text (success pill, success intent bg).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warn text.

tokens.name: rep-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind rep text.

tokens.name: out-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind t-out text — the error pill.

tokens.name: muted-soft
tokens.usage: Halo behind a muted dot (Binder's Offline sync state). From Binder.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Hue: Flow Projects / Dashboard, Binder Script and Sound (SND tint); info intent (4.6:1 on blue-soft in light). Dark text on a blue fill in dark theme, white in light.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Hue: Flow Assets, Binder Cues and Lighting (LX chrome tint). Dark text on an amber fill in both themes (white fails).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Hue: Flow Schedule / Finance, Binder Exports. Dark text on a green fill in dark theme; white in light (5.3:1 since the 2026-10-19 retone).

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Hue: Flow Crew, Binder Activity and TheatreMix (TM chrome tint); 'via agent' in Binder activity. Dark text on it in dark theme, white in light.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Hue: Flow Maintenance, Binder Stage (STG tint). Dark text on it in dark theme, white in light (4.55:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Hue: Flow Warehouse / Test & Tag, Binder Docs and SM (SM tint). Dark text in dark theme, white in light (4.56:1).

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Avatar / data-viz hue; Binder Video (VID chrome tint). No soft fill token.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Avatar / data-viz hue; Binder Flys (FLY tint). No soft fill token. Dark text on it in both themes (4.5:1 in light).

tokens.name: dark
tokens.usage: Espresso near-black: the on-fill text colour for hue fills in dark theme (≥6:1 on every hue), and on amber and lime in light.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill behind blue text/icons: info pill, Projects patch.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill for the Assets module patch.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill for the Schedule / Finance module patch.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill for the Crew module patch.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill for the Maintenance module patch.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill for the Warehouse / compliance module patch.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal and sheet backdrop.

tokens.name: scrim-strong
tokens.usage: Heavier backdrop for full-screen overlays (Binder calling-mode keypad, command palette). From Binder.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected-row background and text selection.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text — always blue, never red. 5.8:1 dark, 4.7:1 light on paper.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Fixed in both themes: the cream button on a full-red block, the cream pricing tier, sticker borders, the mascot's eye glints.

tokens.name: cream-ink
tokens.usage: Fixed: text on cream (15:1).

tokens.name: patch-border
tokens.usage: Fixed in both themes: the sticker / patch die-cut edge everywhere — pack art, marketing stickers and Flow's in-app FeaturePatch (decision 2026-10-19).

tokens.name: warehouse-display-bg
tokens.usage: Fixed, never flips with theme: the warehouse kiosk display background.

tokens.name: gaff-tape-bg
tokens.usage: Fixed: the auth page's gaff-tape sticker.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Binder: the PDF page ground, white in every theme — the brightest thing on screen.

tokens.name: page-ink
tokens.usage: Binder: ink drawn on the page that isn't a department's (note text, tag numbers). 17.8:1 on page.

tokens.name: page-hit
tokens.usage: Binder: search-hit highlighter on the page, used at 55% as a wash. Never a theme token or a department colour.

tokens.name: page-hit-active
tokens.usage: Binder: the search hit being looked at (45% fill + 1pt stroke).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Binder: the dark the script page sits on, in every theme.

tokens.name: dept-lx
tokens.usage: Binder department default, Lighting (LX): ink on white page. Chrome tint on espresso = amber. 3.2:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: dept-snd
tokens.usage: Binder department default, Sound (SND). Chrome tint = blue. 5.0:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: dept-tm
tokens.usage: Binder department default, TheatreMix (TM). Chrome tint = purple. 4.9:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: dept-sm
tokens.usage: Binder department default, Stage management (SM). Chrome tint = teal. 4.1:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: dept-vid
tokens.usage: Binder department default, Video (VID). Chrome tint = pink. 4.6:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: dept-stg
tokens.usage: Binder department default, Stage (STG). Chrome tint = coral. 4.0:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: dept-fly
tokens.usage: Binder department default, Flys (FLY). Chrome tint = lime. 3.9:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: dept-personal
tokens.usage: Binder personal layer default. Chrome tint = muted. 4.8:1 on page — clears the 3:1 mark floor; the cue number beside it is page-ink.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: THE 2px outline: line-2 on dark, full ink on light (the RVLT outline look). Cards, Line buttons, tab lists. Decorative where the container is not a control; controls use input.

tokens.usage: Control boundary: input, select, textarea, combobox, checkbox and switch outlines (control-line, 3:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px core red with a 2px paper offset on every interactive element (3.5:1 or better on every dark surface, 4.7:1 or better light).

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Rail focus ring.
